rationale: Math-only directive bodies are escaped directly into a MathJax display wrapper. Markdown bodies instead pass through protect_math, which respects literal parser ranges and protects explicit delimiters before Markdown smart punctuation runs. The tests pass resulting text back through pulldown-cmark with smart punctuation enabled and verify primes, TeX row breaks, braces, and underscores remain intact. Further tests leave code/link/HTML examples literal and prevent anchor-like text inside math from defining roles. Ordered grammar citations remain grouped in one source selector; author placeholders and mathematical commands are not translated or interpreted as Lean.
